how_to_read: agency_fees and impact_and_connection_fees with verified=true were copied from the fetched source; 'excerpt' is extracted programmatically from the file named in 'raw_file'.
verified=false means NOT confirmed - amount fields are null on purpose.

consultant_costs are MARKET ESTIMATES, never agency fees. amount_low/high are populated only when at least one fetched source supports them; 'unsourced_analyst_estimate' is a clearly separate, unsourced placeholder.
Kitsap DCD land-use fees are flat for two review cycles, then $145/hour; SDAP inspections are hourly on top of the flat fee; SDAP Addendum is deposit-plus-hourly.
Every DCD permit also carries the $90 base fee and 3% technology surcharge unless noted; 'Fee Guide total at submittal' figures in notes include those plus other-agency add-ons.

agency_fees.formula: Building permit fee = project valuation x 0.0224 (includes plan review; for new single-family residences also includes mechanical, plumbing and fixture fees). Valuation = square feet x Kitsap BVD rate (see kitsap-dcd-bvd-* items) or declared value. Then add $90 Base Application Fee + 3% Technology Surcharge + $6.50 State Building Code Council surcharge. Impact fees, Health District and other-agency fees are separate.

building_permit_worked_examples.method: DCD building permit = (sq ft x BVD rate) x 0.0224 + $90 Base Application Fee + 3% Technology Surcharge on the permit fee + $6.50 State Building Code Council surcharge. BVD rates effective 11/1/2026: $177.63/sf new residential space, $69.28/sf garage/unheated.
building_permit_worked_examples.status: COMPUTED by this research from the published formula and rates - not figures printed by the County. Regenerate after each May 1 / November 1 BVD update.
assumptions: 3% technology surcharge applied to the valuation-based permit fee only (matches how the County's own Fee Guide computes it on flat fees).

Excludes: Kitsap Public Health building clearance ($335 on septic; $90/$145 sewered), BSA ($820/$1,085), septic installation permit ($600), impact fees (shown separately), $500 exempt-well fee, L&I electrical, SDAP or Simplified Drainage Review ($1,160) if triggered, sewer/water connection charges, any land-use/critical-area/shoreline permit.
Mechanical/plumbing is included only for NEW single-family residences; for the addition and detached garage, any mechanical/plumbing is a separate valuation-based fee (minimum $75).
Whether the County charges park/school/road impact fees on additions or garages: none expected (no new dwelling unit) - not shown.
ADU impact fees use the '50% of principal dwelling' cap from the Impact Fee Table with an assumed 2,000 sf principal dwelling.
building_permit_worked_examples.cross_check: Kitsap DCD's own 'Funding & Permit Fees' handout (Revised 7/20/2026, raw_fees/kitsap_funding_and_permit_fees.txt) shows a 2026 example for a 2,000 sq ft, 3 bedroom SFR: DCD BUILDING $7,899; ROADS $5,059; SCHOOLS $1,680; PARKS $880. That predates the 11/1/2026 BVD update and the 9/24/26 impact fee table, which is why the figures here ($8,293.05; $5,181.34; $1,720; $900) are slightly higher.
